svg.text: THE MOSS, AFTER 10^200 YEARS - jumped in one step by the matrix cheat
its identity did not change: moss root c11dbcf295a8dee17e308e49... - an identity cannot be violated
still the same moss - its light now #36322b
the moss across the ages (each jump one hash):
final at 10^200: glow #36322b - spread 16,504,776 - the surface transformed past all counting
jumped by indexing, not grown by waiting - the root is the enduring identity, the glow is the surface - SYSTEM_AFFIRMED=0
